Where in Shopify admin: Products > Collections > open or create the collection > Title
What to write or set: The words buyers type. Say what is on the shelf.
Limit or rule: Short. Usually shows as the big heading on the page.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Ceramic Vases

Where in Shopify admin: Collection page > Description
What to write or set: 2 to 4 short sentences: what is in it, who it is for, the choices (sizes, colours, materials), one helpful fact, a link to a related collection.
Limit or rule: About 40 to 80 words above the products, so products still show on a phone screen.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Handmade ceramic vases for dried flowers, fresh stems and shelves. Choose from 3 heights (12, 20 and 30 cm) and 4 glazes: sand, sage, chalk and charcoal. Every vase is glazed inside and holds water. Pair one with our ceramic mugs for a matching gift.

Where in Shopify admin: Collection page > Image
What to write or set: One clear photo of the products on the shelf. Add alt text.
Limit or rule: Same style as your product photos. Check it on phone and desktop, some themes crop it.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Three vases in sand, sage and charcoal on a white shelf

Where in Shopify admin: Collection page > Collection type
What to write or set: Manual: you add each product. Smart: Shopify adds every product that matches your conditions.
Limit or rule: You cannot switch type after you save. Pick Smart for shelves that grow.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Smart

Where in Shopify admin: Collection page > Conditions
What to write or set: One clear rule, for example Product type is equal to Vase.
Limit or rule: Write product type and tags the same way on every product, or products go missing.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Product type is equal to Vase

Where in Shopify admin: Collection page > Products > Sort
What to write or set: Best selling, Newest, Price or Manually. Put your clearest, best-stocked products first.
Limit or rule: Check the first row on a phone. That is what most buyers see first.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Manually: the 3 sand vases first, then sage, chalk, charcoal

Where in Shopify admin: Collection page > Products
What to write or set: Enough products to compare. Merge shelves with only 1 or 2 products.
Limit or rule: No empty collections in your menu.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): 12 vases (3 heights x 4 glazes)

Where in Shopify admin: Online Store > Themes > Customize > Collection template
What to write or set: Check that the collection template shows a filter bar or sidebar.
Limit or rule: Most Online Store 2.0 themes (for example Dawn) support filters.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Dawn theme, filters on the left

Where in Shopify admin: Apps > Search & Discovery (free Shopify app) > Filters > Add filter
What to write or set: Only filters that help on this shelf: availability, price, colour, size, product type, material.
Limit or rule: 4 to 6 is usually enough. Filters read your product data.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Availability, Price, Colour, Height, Material

Where in Shopify admin: Products > open each product > Variants and metafields
What to write or set: One spelling per value, so the filter shows one option, not two.
Limit or rule: Grey or Gray, not both. 20 cm, not 20cm and 20 CM.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Glaze colours: Sand, Sage, Chalk, Charcoal

Where in Shopify admin: Collection page > Search engine listing > Edit > Page title
What to write or set: Main words first, then one key detail, then your brand.
Limit or rule: About 60 characters or less.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Handmade Ceramic Vases in 4 Glazes | Fernmoor

Where in Shopify admin: Collection page > Search engine listing > Edit > Meta description
What to write or set: What is on the shelf, one reason to look, the main choices.
Limit or rule: About 155 characters or less. No promises you cannot keep.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Handmade ceramic vases in 3 sizes and 4 glazes, glazed inside to hold water. Shop sand, sage, chalk and charcoal vases from Fernmoor.

Where in Shopify admin: Collection page > Search engine listing > Edit > URL handle
What to write or set: Short, lowercase, dashes, the main words only.
Limit or rule: If you change it later, keep Create a URL redirect ticked so old links still work.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): ceramic-vases

Where in Shopify admin: Collection page > Image > edit the image
What to write or set: Say what is in the photo in plain words.
Limit or rule: About 125 characters or less. No keyword lists.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Three Fernmoor ceramic vases in sand, sage and charcoal on a white shelf

Where in Shopify admin: Online Store > Themes > Customize > Collection template > add a Collapsible content or FAQ section
What to write or set: 3 to 5 real buyer questions with short, direct answers, below the products.
Limit or rule: Answer in the first sentence. Use a separate collection template if each shelf needs its own questions.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Do the vases hold water? Yes, every vase is glazed inside and holds water for fresh flowers.

Where in Shopify admin: Content > Menus (older admins: Online Store > Navigation) > Main menu > Add menu item
What to write or set: Add the collection so buyers find it in one or two clicks.
Limit or rule: Use the same name as the collection title.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Home decor > Ceramic Vases

Where in Shopify admin: Collection page > Description > link button
What to write or set: Link 1 or 2 related collections with clear link text.
Limit or rule: Link text says where it goes. Not click here.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): ceramic mugs

Where in Shopify admin: Products > open each product > Description
What to write or set: One line at the end of each product description that links back to its collection.
Limit or rule: Same clear link text.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): See all ceramic vases

Where in Shopify admin: Online Store > Themes > Customize > Collection template > add a Collection list section
What to write or set: Show 2 to 4 related shelves under the products.
Limit or rule: Only shelves that make sense next.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Ceramic Mugs, Table Decor, Gifts under 50

Where in Shopify admin: Collection page > Publishing (Online Store) > View
What to write or set: Check the live page on a phone: title, intro, first row of products, filters, links.
Limit or rule: Click every link once.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Live at /collections/ceramic-vases
